propositions: cache writes occur on every plan-review gate call but are never read across different ticket reviews, despite sitting within the 5-minute TTL
the marked cache breakpoint is placed after pass-specific stance suffixes rather than at the shared plan-bearing prefix boundary, preventing within-run reuse between the finder and verifier passes
the plan text is embedded in the marked prefix by design for within-run fan-out caching, so cross-ticket prefix identity is impossible and not the root cause
the diagnostic warn_if_cache_ineffective only detects write==0 AND read==0 cases, leaving the write-every-call-never-read shape invisible to telemetry

moving the cache breakpoint to the end of the byte-stable shared_plan_prefix boundary enables cross-pass reads within one run and same-ticket re-reviews inside the TTL without changing model-visible bytes
